name: rust
description: Clippy in deny mode for the panics, debug output, and unexplained suppressions agents leave behind, plus rustfmt and cargo-deny.

tools.name: rust
tools.why: #[expect] and lint reasons are stable from 1.81

merge.how: In a single crate, append the [lints.rust] and [lints.clippy] tables. In a workspace, add them as [workspace.lints.rust] and [workspace.lints.clippy] in the root Cargo.toml and put `[lints]\nworkspace = true` in every member.

baseline: Clippy has no baseline file. For each file with existing violations, add an inner attribute such as #![expect(clippy::unwrap_used, reason = "faker-kit baseline")] at the top, then add a ratchet rule {"id": "rust-baseline", "pattern": "faker-kit baseline", "files": ["*.rs"]} and run ratchet.mjs update. #[expect] fails once the code is fixed, so baselines remove themselves.
